mzungumzaji)
Mheshimiwa muda wako umemalizika.
…kutakuwa hakuna maji safi nasalama ina maana watu wote watazidi kuathirika na maradhi yataongezeka…
Mheshimiwa Selemani Said Bungara.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kwanza natoa shukurani kwa kunipa nafasi hii ili nichangie. Pili, namshukuru Mwenyezi Mungu ambaye ameumba mbingu na ardhi ili tuitumie sisi binadamu katika maendeleo yetu.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, tunazungumzia habari ya maji na kila kiumbe ana asili ya maji, sisi binadamu tumepatikana kutoka na asili ya maji. Hata hivyo miaka 56
ya Serikali ya CCM tunazungumzia habari ya maji. Tunakwenda vijijini kuomba kura ajenda yetu kubwa ni kwamba mkinichagua kuwa Mbunge mtapata maji, miaka 56.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, amesema Mheshimiwa wa Mtama hapa, Ilani ya CCM mliwaahidi Watanzania kwamba mtapata maji kutoka asilimia 67 mpaka 85. Mimi Jimbo langu au Wilaya yangu ya Kilwa maji vijijini ni asilimia 48.3. Tunaomba sana…
Maji safi na salama?
Maji safi na salama ndiyo. Tunaomba sana, bajeti ya maji lazima iongezwe.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, ikiwa 2016/2017 tulipangiwa au tulipitisha bajeti ya bilioni mia tisa hamsinitukapata asilimia 19, mwaka huu bilioni mia sita sasa ukipata asilimia 16 utajua mwenyewe itakuwa shilingi ngapi maana itapungua. Naomba sana bajeti hii ya maji irudi iende ikaongezwe fedha kama zilivyoongezwa mwaka jana.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, nitazungumzia Mradi wa Maji wa Mavuji. Katika bajeti ya 2016/2017, ukurasa wa 142 kulikuwa na mradi wa maji katika Mji wa Kilwa Masoko. Kazi zitakazofanyika ni ujenzi wa chanzo, mitambo ya kusafishia na kutibu maji, ulazaji wa mabomba, ujenzi wa matanki, ukarabati wa upanuzi wa mabomba ya kusambaza maji. Mahitaji ya fedha euro milioni 61.67. Maelezo, majadiliano ya Serikali na Ubeligiji kupitia kampuni ya Aspec international yanaendelea. Usanifu umekamilika.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, haya! Nataka nijue toka kwa Mheshimiwa Waziri, mazungumzo kati ya Aspec na ninyi yameishia wapi? Mradi huu ungesaidia upatikanaji wa maji katika miji midogo miwili ya Kilwa Kivinje na Mji Mdogo wa Kilwa Masoko, lakini sasa hivi ni miaka mitano maneno tu,
maneno tu, kesho, kesho kutwa, kucha maneno tu. Oh haa! Mheshimiwa Waziri leo nataka aniambie mchakato huu umefikia wapi ama sivyo kwa mara ya kwanza nataka nitoe shilingi;.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, naomba sana. Serikali ya CCM kwa miaka 56 imeshindwa, tunataka kuiangalia Serikali ya Magufuli, maana Serikali CCM haipo, sasa hivi kuna Serikali ya Magufuli. Tunataka tuione Serikali ya Magufuli kwa miaka hii mitano itamaliza tatizo la maji? Kama haikumaliza tatizo la maji katika Tanzania, basi Magufuli bye bye

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, tunaomba sana Serikali ya Magufuli ikishindwa kutatua tatizo la maji bye bye mwaka 2020, kwa herini. Waheshimiwa maji si mchezo, huwezi kuishi bila maji, huwezi kulala na mama bila maji.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, tunaomba sana, bila maji hakuna kila kitu, watoto hawapatikani bila maji. Tunaomba hilo jambo la maji na hii bajeti lazima irekebishwe ili Watanzania tupate maji. Naunga mkono kabisa; utampata wapi mtoto bila maji? (Vicheko/Makofi)

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, jambo lingine kule Kilwa kuna mradi wa maji tangu mwaka 1992, Kilwa sehemu ya Mpala. Watu walitathminiwa lakini tangu 1992 mpaka leo hawajalipwa fidia, mpaka leo! Maji wameyachukua Mpala wameyapeleka Masoko lakini Mpala penyewe pale maji hakuna.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, naomba sana katika majumuisho leo Mheshimiwa Waziri aniambie watu wa Mpala fidia yao watalipwa lini? Naomba sana na Mheshimiwa Naibu Waziri wa Maji alikuja Mpala na akawaahidi watu wa Mpala kwamba lazima hela zao watapata, nataka nijue leo Serikali sikivu ya Mheshimiwa Magufuli mtoe kauli leo nisikie kama si hivyo sijapata jibu sawasawa nasema kweli Serikali ya Mheshimiwa Magufuli si Serikali sikivu. Kama sikivu kweli nijue kwamba watu wale fidia zao zimetoka au zitatoka lini.

Mheshimia Naibu Spika, naomba sana msimtie aibu Mheshimiwa Magufuli, Magufuli ni mzuri pengine wabaya ni ninyi hapo. Magufuli mzuri ana tatizo moja tu, anabinya demokrasia, hapo tatizo analo, lakini mengine hana matatizo.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, naomba sana; kuna matatizo…
(Hapa kengele ililia kuashiria kuisha kwa muda wa
mzungumzaji)
Mheshimiwa Bungara muda wako umemalizika.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, aah! bado bwana!
Tukumbushe tu jina lako lile lingine bado unatumia au umeacha?
Ninalo Bwege na wewe mjinga sawasawa tu.
Ahsante sana, Mheshimiwa Seif Gulamali atafuatiwa na Mheshimiwa Anna Lupembe. Kama muda utaruhusu basi Mheshimiwa Josephine Genzabuke atazungumza pia.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, nashukuru sana kwa kunipa nafasi ya kuchangia leo katika Wizara hii ya Maji na Umwagiliaji.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kwanza kabisa nitakuwa mchoyo wa fadhila nisipotoa shukrani zetu hasa kwa watu wa Manonga, Wilaya ya Igunga ama Mkoa wa Tabora kwa Mheshimiwa Rais wa Jamhuri ya Muungano wa Tanzania Dkt. John Pombe Magufuli, lakini pia kwa Wizara ya Maji na Umwagiliaji hasa baada ya kusaini ule mkataba wa maji ya Ziwa Victoria Mkoani Tabora hivi karibuni.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, naamini mradi huu wa maji ya Ziwa Victoria unaenda kupunguza uhaba ama tatizo la maji hasa kwa wananchi wetu ambao ni wa hali ya chini sana. Mradi huu katika kupita utapita katika maeneo ya vijijini, kwa hiyo vijiji ambavyo vitapitiwa na mradi ule vitapata maji. Hii yote ni shukrani kwa Mheshimiwa Rais kwa kuamua kujitoa kwa hali na mali kuhakikisha kwamba analitatua tatizo hili la maji katika maeneo ambayo yalikuwa yana shida ya maji kwa muda mrefu.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, niseme, mradi huu wakati unakwenda pale Igunga maeneo kama Ziba, Ibologelo, Nyandekwa, Ndembezi pamoja na Kata zilizopo jirani pale maana ni kilometa kumi na mbili yatapata maji ya Ziwa Victoria. Vile vile naamini mpaka Nkinga pale kwenye Hospitali yetu ya Rufaa maji yatafika kwa sababu ni Hospitali ya Rufaa ambayo inatoa huduma maeneo mbalimbali, maji na wao watapata.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kwa hiyo maji ni uhai na kama alivyosema Mheshimiwa aliyetoka hapa bila maji huwezi kufanya mambo yoyote, lakini kwa programu hii namshukuru sana Mheshimiwa Rais na Wizara. Niombe tu hii progamu iende kama ilivyopangwa na naamini kufikia 2018 maji yatakuwa yanatiririka katika maeneo yetu. Nawashukuru sana.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, nizungumzie mambo machache ambayo napenda leo nichangie, ni kuhusu masuala ya uchimbaji wa mabwawa. Tumeona kila Mbunge anazungumzia maji hapa na tumeona kuna baadhi ya maeneo mvua zinanyesha kwa kasi sana kiasi kwamba inapeleka mpaka mafuriko.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, sasa niombe Wizara hii iangalie katika masuala kama haya maji mengi yanapotea; tungechimba mabwawa makubwa ambayo yangesaidia kuhifadhi haya maji kwa sababu maji mengi yanapotea. Sehemu nyingine Mwenyezi Mungu amejalia tuna mvua za kutosha lakini baada ya mvua kukatika na maji yanapotea
na shida ya maji inaendelea kuwepo katika yale yale maeneo ambayo mvua nyingi zilinyesha.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, niiombe Wizara iliangalie jambo hili kwa macho mawili. Hata nikitolea tu mfano pale kwetu Choma Chankola kulikuwa na survey ilifanyika ilitolewa milioni thelathini na tano ya kuchimba bwawa na usanifu ukafanyika, lakini ule uchimbaji wa bwawa sijui umepotelea wapi, imekuwa kimya. Kila mwaka tunaulizia. Mwaka jana nilizungumza hili suala na mwaka huu tena nagusia Mheshimiwa Waziri amesahau ama ile fedha iliyotolewa milioni thelathini na tano walitoa sadaka?

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, naamini wanavyotoa fedha baadaye inafuata mipango ya utekelezaji. Sasa tumetoa milioni thelathini na tano, isipotee, naomba mabwawa haya yachimbwe katika maeneo ambayo maporomoko ya maji yapo mengi hasa Choma, Ziba pale kuna maji mengi sana na kilimo cha mpunga, lakini pia mabwawa maeneo ya Simbo nashukuru sasa hivi kuna NGO ya World Vision wana programu ya uchimbaji wa bwawa.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, niombe sasa Serikali mshirikiane na hii NGO ili tuweze kuhakikisha kwamba hii programu yao ya uchimbaji wa bwawa kubwa pale Simbo iweze kukamilika na kufikia mwisho ili kuhakikisha kwamba maeneo jirani yanapata haya maji ambayo yatawasaidia kwenye kilimo cha umwagiliaji.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, lakini pamoja na kuchangia kwenye ishu ya mabwawa Mheshimiwa Waziri mimi nigusie; tuna miradi inayofadhiliwa ama tunaopata miradi katika maeneo yetu ya maji vijijini. Tunatumia fedha nyingi sana kutengeneza miradi ya maji katika vijiji vyetu, lakini tuna shida ya kukosa wataalam wa kusimamia ile miradi na inapelekea miradi ile baada ya muda mfupi inakufa. Kwa mfano kuna mradi wa usambazaji wa maji katika Kijiji cha Choma namba sita pale Matinje, ukienda Ziba mradi wa maji upo, ukienda Ndembezi, Nkinga na Simbo kote kuna miradi wa maji. Tatizo wanakosa wataalam wanaachiwa Serikali za Vijiji wale
Wenyeviti wa Vitongoji na Wajumbe mwisho wa siku wanakusanya fedha na baada ya kupata mapato wanazila zile hela.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, niombe sisi Wizara, katika maeneo ambayo kuna miradi, tuajiri au tupeleke mtaalam pale aweze kusimamia na kuwaongoza hawa viongozi na watu ambao wanasimamia huu mradi wa maji. Niiombe Wizara iliangalie hili suala ili ihakikishe kwamba inaokoa fedha ambazo zimekwishatumika katika uchimbaji ama uwepo wa miradi ile ya maji.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, pia niiombe Wizara katika ile miradi yao wanayopata ya ufadhili wa World Bank ya uchimbaji wa visima virefu, niombe watuangalie na sisi pale Igunga hasa Manonga kwa sababu yako maeneo yana shida sana ya maji. Tuna shida kweli ya maji hasa ukiangalia kuna baadhi ya vijiji; naweza nikamtajia ama nitamletea Mheshimiwa Waziri kwenye taarifa yake atusaidie. Kuna maeneo kama Kata za Mwamala, Uswaya, Igoweko, Kitangili, Nyandekwa na Mwansugho Ngulu, maeneo yote hayo hayana maji.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kwa hiyo, tuiombe Wizara katika ule ufadhili wanaoupata kutoka World Bank na maeneo mengine waiangalie Wilaya yetu wahakikishe kwamba tunapata visima hivyo virefu angalau; maana bajeti imekwisha sijaona kisima hata kimoja ndani ya Wilaya yangu ya Igunga. Sasa niiombe Wizara iangalie hili suala na iweze kupitia ili waweze kutusaidia kutatua hii changamoto ya maji.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, lakini lingine nipende kushauri tu kwa Mheshimiwa Waziri, waliangalie kwenye Wizara. Nilihudhuria kwenye bajeti moja ya Kamati ya Fedha Wilayani pale Igunga. Tumekaa zimekuja fedha za maji milioni ishirini nafikiri, kuna mradi fulani wa maji vijijini; lakini wanasema katika hii milioni ishirini mwongozo kutoka Wizarani asilimia 30 ya fedha ni kwa ajili ya usimamizi wa miradi hii. Milioni ishirini, usimamizi ni milioni sita maana yake
ni kwamba kwenye milioni ishirini unatoa sita inabaki milioni 14. Sasa kwa vijiji sijui 14 vile vitagawana shilingi ngapi ngapi?

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, hebu tuangalie kama ni mwongozo kweli wa asilimia 30 kama ni kweli, maana wameniambia wataalam wilayani, huu ni mwongozo wa Wizara, tunakata asilimia 30 kwa ajili ya usimamizi; nikauliza usimamizi gani? Wanasema kwamba sijui kuna mafuta na posho, ukipiga mahesabu hazifiki milioni sita au saba. Sasa leo tuna programu ya bilioni…
Mheshimiwa Gulamali muda wako umemalizika.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, nashukuru sana na naunga mkono hoja, niiombe Wizara ifuatilie hizi fedha ambazo zinakuja kwenye Halmashauri. Ahsante sana.
Ahsante. Mheshimiwa Anna Lupembe.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, ahsante kwa kunipa nafasi ya kuweza kuzungumza bajeti hii muhimu sana ya maji, kwa sababu maji ni uhai, bila maji hatuwezi kuishi, kila binadamu lazima atumie maji ili aweze kuishi. Bajeti hii tunaiomba Serikali kwa ajili ni jambo muhimu sana kwa binadamu tunaomba iongezwe kama ilivyokuwa 2016/2017 kwa sababu maji ni uhai.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, naomba nimpongeze Mheshimiwa Waziri pamoja na Mheshimiwa Naibu Waziri kwa kazi kubwa ambayo wanaifanya, tunaona jinsi gani wanavyoipigania Wizara yao kwa ajili ya kufungua miradi mbalimbali. Hata hivyo, bado kaka zangu wana kazi kubwa sana kwa sababu Wizara waliyokuwa nayo ni ngumu sana inawagusa wananchi moja kwa moja.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, tumeomba bajeti iongezwe kwa sababu kama nilivyosema maji ni muhimu sana kwa binadamu. Vilevile ukiangalia kuna mifuko mbalimbali ambayo tunaiona imefanya kazi vizuri. Tukizingatia REA imefanya kazi vizuri sana kwa upande wa umeme. Tulikuwa tunaiomba Serikali kwenye tozo ya Mfuko wa Barabara tutoe at least shilingi hamsini, Mfuko wa Umeme tutoe shilingi hamsini ili iwe shilingi mia iende kwenye Mfuko wa Maji.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, tunaona ni jinsi gani REA ilivyofanya kazi vizuri ndani ya vijiji vyetu; leo hii wananchi wanafurahi wanapata huduma safi ya mwanga. Sasa maji ni uhai, kila mtu anahitaji maji na tukiangalia maeneo yetu ya vijijini hakuna maji kabisa, akina mama wanahangaika. Tukienda kwenye ziara zetu, ndiyo maana unakuta Waheshimiwa Wabunge wengi wanapiga kelele kwa sababu ya maji kwa kuwa tunapokwenda kwenye ziara zetu huko tunaona hali halisia ya jinsi gani maji hakuna.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, akinamama wanatoka saa tisa za usiku, vijiji vingine saa nane za usiku wanakwenda kutafuta maji na akienda kutafuta maji hapati yale maji safi na salama anapata maji machafu. Matokeo yake sasa unakuta asilimia kubwa ya maji yale ya vijijini ambayo ni ya vijito kuna maradhi mengi yanapatikanika huko, watu wanaumwa vichocho na kuharisha. Halafu sasa hivi mpaka mijini kwa sababu hatutumii maji safi na salama, mjini sehemu nyingi maji hayatibiwi matokeo yake watu asilimia 90 tunapata magonjwa ya UTI.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, sasa tunaomba Serikali kwa hili sasa hivi lazima tujipange vizuri, bajeti ongezeke ili nchi yetu ya Tanzania tuweze kujivunia kwa hilo. Tunaomba asilimia 70 iende vijijini na asilimia 30 ibaki mjini kwa sababu mijini kuna miradi mbalimbali mikubwa ambayo inatekelezeka.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, naomba niende sasa kwangu Mpanda. Naomba niishukuru Serikali kwa sababu Mpanda tuna miradi mikubwa kama vile mradi wa Ikolongo ambao umefanyika na sasa asilimia 60 ya wananchi wa Mpanda wanapata maji, lakini asilimia 40 pale Manispaa hawapati maji. Hapa ndani ya ukurasa wa 66 Mpanda kuna huu mradi wa mwaka 2016/2017 tulipangiwa bilioni mbili. Huwezi ukaamini kuna watu wanatafuta maslahi yao wenyewe badala ya kutafuta maslahi ya wananchi.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, pesa hizi zilivyofika Mpanda Tender Board imerudiwa mara tatu, mpaka leo ninavyokwambia mradi huu unakutana na pesa za bajeti hii ya 2017/2018. Mradi haujatekelezeka kwa sababu ya ubinafsi; watu wanataka maslahi yao wenyewe binafsi badala ya maslahi ya wananchi. Wananchi wa Mpanda wanahangaika maji wenyewe wanataka waweze kupata mradi wajinufaishe wao. Inasikitisha sana kwa Mpanda!

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, naiomba Serikali Mheshimiwa Waziri, najua sasa hivi Tender Board ime-tender mara tatu kiasi ambacho wamekwenda kushtakiana kwa ajili ya ubinafsi. Naomba Mheshimiwa Waziri alifuatilie hili jambo ili wananchi wa Mpanda Mjini waweze kupata maji, mradi huu uweze kufanyika na hizi bilioni mbili ziweze kufanya kazi kutoka Kanoge mpaka Mpanda.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, leo hii Hospitali ya Mpanda Mjini ambayo wananchi tunaitegemea haina maji, na huu mradi wa bilioni mbili ulitegemewa ukifika pale maji yafike kwenye Hospitali yetu ya Mpanda Mjini.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, naomba hizi bilioni mbili ambazo zilikuwa za bajeti iliyopita ziweze kufanya kazi na kama safari hii wametupangia bajeti vilevile iweze kufanya kazi kwa sababu wananchi wa Mpanda Mjini wanapata tabu
kwa sababu ya watu wachache ambao wanataka maslahi yao binafsi.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, leo hii sisi Mkoa wa Katavi tuna Ziwa Tanganyika; sisi tunafurahi wenzetu hapa wana Ziwa Victoria leo ziwa lile limewapa manufaa. Hata hivyo, sisi Wanakatavi tuna Ziwa Tanganyika ambalo lina kina kirefu, kina chake kirefu kushinda Ziwa Victoria. Kwa nini sasa Serikali na Ziwa Tanganyika…
(Hapa kengele ililia kuashiria kuisha kwa muda wa
mzungumzaji)
Mheshimiwa muda wako umekwisha.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, naunga mkono hoja. Ahsante sana.
Ahsante sana. Mheshimiwa Josephine Genzabuke, kama bado tutakuwa na nafasi Mheshimiwa Edward mwalongo ajiandae.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, nakushukuru kwa kunipa nafasi ili na mimi niweze kuchangia hoja iliyopo mbele yetu.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kwanza kabisa naomba niipongeze Serikali ya awamu ya tano kwa jinsi inavyofanya kazi vizuri, na Serikali hiyo inayoongozwa na Mheshimiwa John Pombe Magufuli na kama anavyosema sisi Watanzania tuendelee kumuombea na kweli sisi tunamwombea Mwenyezi Mungu amjalie afya ili aweze kuendelea kuwatumikia Watanzania. Nampongeza Mheshimiwa Waziri, Naibu Waziri, Katibu Mkuu na watendaji wote wa Wizara ya Maji.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kabla ya kuendelea na hotuba yangu naomba niunge mkono hotuba hii kwa ajili ya wanawake wa Tanzania. Naomba niunge mkono hotuba hii kwa ajili ya wanawake wa Mkoa wa Kigoma na Wilaya zake zote.

Mheshimiwa Mwenyekiti, kwa nini naunga mkono bajeti hii? Wakati naunga mkono bajeti hii, naomba bajeti hii iongezewe pesa ili iweze kumkomboa mwanamke wa Tanzania kwa kumpatia maji. Tusipojipanga kuongeza bajeti hii, tujipange kuja na bajeti ya dharura ya kutibu kipindupindu. Kwa maana hiyo, naomba pesa ziongezwe kwenye Wizara hii.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, naomba niseme yafuatayo:-

Naishukuru Serikali kwa sababu mwaka 2016/2017 ilitupangia pesa Mkoa wa Kigoma, nawashukuru kwa hilo. Naomba niseme, pamoja na pesa hizo zilizopangwa, bado lipo tatizo la maji. Kwa hiyo, naendelea kusisitiza kwamba pesa zikipangwa zipelekwe ili kuweza kukamilisha miradi iliyokwishaanzishwa katika Mkoa wa Kigoma. Nimeona wakati Waziri anatoa hotuba yake amesema tumepangiwa pesa nyingine, namwomba Mheshimiwa Waziri pesa hizo zipelekwe ili kuweza kukamilisha miradi iliyopo Kigoma.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, sambamba na hilo, maji ni uhai. Sisi wote tunafahamu maji ni uhai na maji ni kila kitu. Kwa hiyo, naomba bajeti hii iongezewe pesa kwa sababu wanawake wanapojifungua wanahitaji maji. Wanawake pamoja na watu wengine wanaotunza familia; zipo familia ambazo zina wagonjwa wanaohitaji kutumia maji na wanatumia muda mwingi kwenda kutafuta maji. Wakati mwingine wanatafuta maji na wanakosa muda wa kwenda kufanya shughuli za ujasiriamali.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kwa hiyo, maji ni kila kitu. Maji yanachangia wananchi kuweza kuongeza kipato chao. Kwa mfano, sasa hivi tunahamasisha vikundi, wanawake

waanzishe vikundi. Wakitumia muda mwingi kwenda kutafuta maji, watashindwa kufanya shughuli za uzalishaji na watashindwa kujiunga kwenye vikundi na hata wakijiunga hawataweza kurejesha mikopo katika vikundi vyao kwa sababu muda mwingi watakuwa wanautumia kwenda kutafuta maji.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, upo mpango wa kutafuta maji kutoka Mto Malagarasi. Kwa sasa hivi, maji katika Mto Malagarasi yanapungua na vyanzo vingi vinaendelea kuharibika kwa sababu wafugaji wanapeleka mifugo kwenye vyanzo vya maji. Naomba basi tunapopanga bajeti kwa ajili ya kupeleka maji vijijini tupeleke na pesa kwa ajili ya kwenda kuhamasisha wananchi kutunza mazingira kwa ajili ya kuhifadhi misitu ili maji yasipotee.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, pamoja na mipango mizuri ya kutoa maji Mto Malagarasi lakini tusisahau kufanya mipango ya kutumia Ziwa Tanganyika, kwa sababu Ziwa Tanganyika ni ziwa kubwa ambalo linaweza likasambaza maji maeneo mengi. Maji hayo yakisambazwa katika maeneo mbalimbali, tutafanikiwa katika kilimo cha umwagiliaji. Kwa maana hiyo, Tanzania yenye viwanda itawezekana kwa sababu wananchi watakuwa wanazalisha mazao yao na kupelekea viwanda kuanzishwa kwa sababu vitu ambavyo vitakuwa vimelimwa kutoka mashambani vitakuwa vinapatikana kutokana na kilimo cha umwagiliaji.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, naomba Serikali ipeleke pesa hizo ili kuweza kukamilisha miradi katika Mji wa Kasulu na viunga vyake ambako bado kuna maeneo yana matatizo ya maji. Mji wa Kibondo nao unahitaji pesa kwa ajili ya kukamilisha miradi ya maji. Vile vile Mji wa Kakonko unahitaji pesa. Kwa mfano, upo mradi mkubwa wa Mgembezi ambapo mradi huo ukikamilika utaweza kuhudumia Kata karibu tano. Kwa mfano Kata ya Kasuga, Kata ya Kakonko, Kata ya Kanyonza, Kata ya Kiziguzigu na Kata ya Kasanda. Kwa hiyo, tunaomba kabisa pesa hizo zikipatikana zielekezwe huko kwenda kukamilisha miradi ambayo tayari imeshaanzishwa. Ipo miradi mingine iliyoanza
kutoka miaka takriban mitano hadi kumi, lakini bado haijaweza kukamilika. Tunaomba pesa zikipatikana zipelekwe zikakamilishe miradi.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, naiomba Serikali iongeze bajeti kwa ajili ya Wizara ya Maji ili tuweze kupeleka maji katika maeneo mbalimbali kumsaidia mwanamke wa Tanzania aweze kupata maji na kumtua ndoo kichwani kama Mheshimiwa Rais wetu alivyoahidi. Nami naamini Rais wetu akiahidi, kwa sababu tumeona mambo mengi aliyoahidi, aliahidi ndege, tayari sasa hivi ndege zipo. Zamani ilikuwa ni shida kutoka Dar es Salaam kwenda Kigoma, lakini kwa ahadi aliyoahidi, sasa hivi bombardier inaenda Kigoma, inaenda Tabora na maeneo mengine. Kwa maana hiyo, naamini hata tatizo la maji litakwisha.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, baada ya kusema maneno hayo, naunga mkono hoja.
Ahsante sana. Waheshimiwa Wabunge, nilikuwa nimemtaja Mheshimiwa Edward Franz Mwalongo, lakini atakuwa mchangiaji wetu wa kwanza kesho kwa ajili ya kukamilisha uwiano wa wachangiaji humu ndani.
Sasa tunaendelea na shughuli iliyopo mbele yetu. Katibu.
UCHAGUZI WA WABUNGE WA BUNGE LA
AFRIKA MASHARIKI (EALA)
Waheshimiwa Wabunge, nitampisha sasa Mheshimiwa Spika ili aweze kuendelea na hiyo hoja iliyo mbele yetu sasa.
Hapa Spika (Mhe. Job Y. Ndugai) Alikalia Kiti
Waheshimiwa Wabunge, ahsanteni sana.

Kabla hatujaendelea, napenda kuchukua nafasi hii kuwashukuru sana wasaidizi wangu wote hapa Mezani kwa kazi nzuri sana ambayo wamekuwa wakiifanya; Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, Mheshimiwa Chenge, Mheshimiwa Zungu na Mheshimiwa Najma. Naomba niseme nawashukuru sana na tuendelee kuchapa kazi hapa Mezani kama kawaida. Katibu.
Uchaguzi wa Wabunge wa Bunge la Afrika Mashariki, maelezo ya Spika.
MAELEZO YA SPIKA

Waheshimiwa Wabunge, naomba sasa mtulie kwenye viti vyenu, tupunguze hii tembea tembea kwa sababu tuna zoezi maalum na muhimu. Kama hatutasikilizana, itatuchukulia muda mrefu bila sababu. Naomba sana kila Mheshimiwa akae kwenye kiti chake. Wale ambao hawakai, nitaanza kuwataja majina.

Niwakumbushe, kwa wakati fulani shughuli hii itakuwa Live. Kwa hiyo, ukitajwa jina hapa wapiga kura wako wakikusikia, itakuwa tabu. Naomba wale mnaoongea, mwambie mwenzako kwamba akae chini. Pia naomba utulivu, kutembeatembea kuishe. Ahsante sana.
Waheshimiwa Wabunge, nina maelezo machache kabla hatujaanza kwenye zoezi letu lililo mbele yetu nalo ni kuhusiana na uchaguzi wa Wabunge wawili wa Afrika ya Mashariki.

Waheshimiwa Wabunge, mtakumbuka kwamba tarehe 4 Aprili, 2017 wakati wa Kikao cha Kwanza cha Mkutano huu wa Saba Bunge lilifanya uchaguzi wa kuwapata Wabunge wa Bunge la Nne la Jumuiya ya Afrika ya Mashariki (EALA) chini ya masharti ya Ibara ya 50 (1) na ya (2) ya mkataba wa kuanzisha Jumuiya hiyo na Kanuni za Kudumu za Bunge, Toleo la Januari, 2016.

Waheshimiwa Wabunge, katika uchaguzi huo, Bunge lilifanikiwa kuwapata Wabunge kutoka kundi A ambapo Wabunge wawili wanawake walichaguliwa; Kundi B ambapo Wabunge wawili kutoka Tanzania, Zanzibar walichaguliwa; Kundi C Vyama vya Upinzani, CUF ambapo Mbunge mmoja alichaguliwa; na Kundi D ambapo Wabunge wawili wa Tanzania Bara walichaguliwa. Kupitia mchanganuo huo tukawa tumepata wawakilishi wetu saba.

Waheshimiwa Wabunge, kwa hiyo, mtakumbuka kwamba katika uchaguzi huo wa kundi C sasa, Vyama vya Upinzani; kwa upande wa CHADEMA uchaguzi huo haukukamilika, baada ya wagombea wawili wa chama hicho kushindwa kupata kura za kutosha na hivyo kutochaguliwa na Bunge wakati huo.

Baada ya hatua hiyo nilielekeza kwamba uchaguzi huo utafanyika baadaye baada ya Chama cha CHADEMA kufanya mchakato upya wa kuwapata wagombea wengine na hatua nyingine za kikanuni za kufanya uchaguzi upya kukamilishwa na Msimamizi wa Uchaguzi ambaye ni Katibu wetu wa Bunge.

Kwa hiyo, napenda kuwajulisha kuwa sasa mchakato huo umekamilika na uchaguzi huo wa kuwapata Wabunge wawili kutoka CHADEMA utafanyika leo kama inavyoonekana kwenye orodha ya shughuli za leo ili Bunge letu liweze kukamilisha nafasi tisa za Wabunge zinazotakiwa kwa kila nchi mwanachama wa Jumuiya ya Afrika Mashariki. Hivyo basi, ili tuweze kuendelea na zoezi hili la uchaguzi, sasa nimpe nafasi Katibu wa Bunge ambaye ndiye msimamizi wa uchaguzi, awasilishe maelezo na utaratibu mzima wa uchaguzi.
Katibu, karibu.
Maelezo ya Msimamizi wa Uchaguzi kuhusu mchakato wa uteuzi wa utaratibu wa kuwapata Wabunge wawili wa Bunge la Afrika Mashariki.

Mheshimiwa Spika, naomba nirejee maelezo ili kuweka rekodi sahihi. Tarehe 4 Aprili, Bunge la Jamhuri ya Muungano wa Tanzania lilifanya uchaguzi wa kuwachagua Wabunge tisa wa Bunge la Afrika Mashariki watakaowakilisha katika Bunge la Afrika Mashariki.

Mheshimiwa Spika, katika uchaguzi huo, Bunge liliwachagua Wabunge sita kutoka Chama cha Mapinduzi na Mbunge mmoja kutoka Chama cha Wananchi CUF. Wabunge wawili kutoka Chama cha Demokrasia na Maendeleo walikosa kura za kutosha kuwapatia ushindi. Hivyo Bunge lilipaswa kufanya uchaguzi kwa ajili ya kuwapata wawakilishi wawili kutoka katika kundi la Vyama vya Upinzani ambapo Chama cha Demokrasia na Maendeleo (CHADEMA) ndicho chenye haki ya kujaza nafasi hizo.

Mheshimiwa Spika, katika mazingira hayo na kwa kuzingatia masharti ya sheria na kanuni zinazotawala uchaguzi huu, nilitoa taarifa ya siku ya uteuzi na siku ya uchaguzi kwenye Gazeti la Serikali Na. 537 la tarehe 21, Aprili, 2017. Taarifa hiyo ilitaja siku ya uteuzi (nomination day) kwa Wagombea kuwa ni tarehe 3 Mei, 2017 saa 1.00 jioni na siku ya uchaguzi (election day) kuwa ni tarehe 10 Mei, 2017.

Mheshimiwa Spika, hata hivyo, tarehe 28, Aprili, Chama cha CHADEMA kiliniandikia barua iliyopokelewa na ofisi yangu siku ya tarehe 2 Mei, jioni. Barua hiyo ilitoa maelezo kwamba muda niliowapa kuwasilisha majina ya Wagombea kupitia kwenye taarifa hiyo ni finyu kutokana na kuathiriwa na kuwepo kwa siku za mapumziko ya mwisho wa wiki pamoja na sikukuu ya Mei Mosi iliyoangukia siku ya Jumatatu, hivyo kuwepo kwa ugumu wa kufanya vikao vyao vya kichama.

Hivyo, chama hicho kiliomba kuongezewa muda usiopungua wiki mbili ili kuweza kufanya uteuzi wa Wagombea, kupata uthibitisho wa uraia kutoka Idara ya Uhamiaji na uthibitisho wa sifa za Wagombea kutoka Tume ya Taifa ya Uchaguzi kwa mujibu wa Ibara ya 50(2) ya
mkataba wa Jumuiya ya Afrika Mashariki ikisomwa pamoja na Ibara ya 67 ya Katiba ya Jamhuri ya Muungano wa Tanzania.

Mheshimiwa Spika, kutokana na sababu zilizotolewa, niliongeza muda wa siku nne, kuanzia tarehe 3 - 7 Mei, 2017 ili kukiwezesha Chama cha CHADEMA kukamilisha taratibu hizo za kisheria na hivyo kukitaka chama hicho kuwasilisha kwangu majina na nyaraka za Wagombea waliowateua tarehe 8 Mei, 2017 kabla ya saa 10.00 jioni ambayo ilikuwa siku ya uteuzi. Chama cha CHADEMA kiliwasilisha kwangu majina sita ya Wagombea ambapo kati yao Wagombea wanne ni wanaume na Wagombea wawili ni wanawake. Majina hayo ya Wagombea yaliwasilishwa kwangu tarehe 8 Mei, 2017 kabla ya saa 10.00 jioni kama ambavyo nilikuwa nimeelekeza.

Mheshimiwa Spika, baada ya hatua hiyo, nilifanya uchambuzi wa nyaraka na kuridhika kwamba Wagombea wote wametimiza masharti ya kugombea baada ya kupata uthibitisho wa uraia kutoka Idara ya Uhamiaji na uthibitisho wa sifa za kugombea kutoka Tume ya Taifa ya Uchaguzi kwa mujibu wa Ibara ya 50 ya Mkataba wa Jumuiya ya Afrika Mashariki ikisomwa pamoja na Ibara ya 67 ya Katiba ya Jamhuri ya Muungano wa Tanzania. Aidha, nimeridhika kuwa uteuzi wa Wagombea umezingatia na kuakisi (reflect) uwepo wa jinsia zote mbili ambapo Wagombea wanne ni wanaume na wawili ni wanawake kama inavyoelekezwa na masharti ya Kifungu cha (4) cha Sheria ya Uchaguzi wa Wabunge wa Bunge la Afrika Mashariki.

Mheshimiwa Spika, vilevile nimepokea nyaraka zote muhimu zinazohitajika kwa mujibu wa Kanuni ya 5(1), (2) na (3); na Kanuni ya (6) ya Nyongeza ya Tatu ya Kanuni za Kudumu za Bunge, Toleo la 2016. Hivyo, nimeridhika kuwa mchakato wa uteuzi wa Wagombea hao katika Chama cha CHADEMA ulikuwa wa kidemokrasia na wa wazi.
Mheshimiwa Spika, baada ya hatua hiyo, nilitoa taarifa na kuwatangazia wafuatao kuwa Wagombea katika
uchaguzi huo wa leo; naomba niwataje. Profesa Abdallah Jumbe Safari…
Hapana, hapana, msipige makofi wala nini. Ninyi sikilizeni majina tu.
Ndugu Ezekia Dibogo Wenje, Ndugu Josephine Sebastian Lemoyani, Ndugu Lawrence Kego Masha, Ndugu Pamela Simon Massay na Ndugu Salum Mwalim Juma.
Mheshimiwa Spika, baada ya zoezi hilo, naomba sasa nieleze utaratibu wa uchaguzi:-

Mheshimiwa Spika, Wagombea kujieleza na kuomba kura. Kila Mgombea ataitwa na kuingia ndani ya Ukumbi wa Bunge kwa kusindikizwa na Mpambe wa Bunge. Mgombea atapewa nafasi ya kujieleza na kuomba kura kwa lugha ya Kiingereza kwa muda usiozidi dakika tatu.

Mheshimiwa Spika, maswali kwa Wagombea. Baada ya kujieleza, Mgombea anaweza kuulizwa maswali yasiyozidi matatu kutoka kwa wapigakura kwa kadri itakavyoelekezwa na Mheshimiwa Spika. Maswali yatakayoulizwa yanapaswa kuwa ya msingi na siyo yale yanayohusu masuala binafsi ya Mgombea. Maswali hayo yatajibiwa na Mgombea kwa kadri ya uelewa wake kuhusiana na swali aliloulizwa. Maswali yataulizwa na kujibiwa kwa lugha ya Kiingereza na kwa mujibu wa Kanuni za Kudumu za Bunge. Mara baada ya kujibu maswali atakayoulizwa Mgombea, Spika atamruhusu Mgombea kutoka nje ya Ukumbi wa Bunge na kuelekea eneo ambalo atakuwa ameandaliwa kwa ajili ya kusubiri.

Mheshimiwa Spika, kupata idadi ya wapigakura. Baada ya Wagombea kujieleza na kuulizwa maswali, kengele itapigwa ili Wabunge wote waingie ndani ya ukumbi kuanza zoezi la upigaji kura. Katika hatua hii, Maafisa watakaokuwa wameandaliwa watahesabu Wabunge walioko ndani ili kupata idadi kamili ya Wabunge waliohudhuria na kupiga kura. Lengo la zoezi hili ni kujiridhisha na uwepo wa akidi

inayotakiwa kwa ajili ya kuwezesha kikao cha uchaguzi kufanyika. Akidi inayohitajika kwa mujibu wa Ibara ya 94 ya Katiba na Kanuni ya 77(1) ya Kanuni za Bunge ni nusu ya Wabunge wote ambayo ni 197. Aidha, zoezi hili litawezesha kupata idadi kamili ya Wabunge waliohudhuria na kupiga kura. Idadi hiyo itatumika kama idadi ya wapigakura katika zoezi la kuhesabu kura.
Mheshimiwa Spika, utaratibu wa kupiga kura. Naomba mnisikilize kidogo, zoezi la kupiga kura litakuwa kama ifuatavyo:-

Mheshimiwa Spika, masanduku (Ballot boxes) yatakaguliwa mbele yenu. Pili, ugawaji wa karatasi za kura na utaratibu wa kupiga kura. Utaratibu wa leo utakuwa na mabadiliko. Wagombea watakapomaliza kujieleza, kila mpiga kura, kwa utaratibu utakaokuwa umeandaliwa watakuja mbele ya meza, utachukua karatasi ya kura, utapiga kura na kuidumbukiza ndani ya box mbele ya meza jirani na siwa.
Mheshimiwa Spika, naomba nirejee tena. Karatasi za kura zitatolewa mbele ya meza na kila mpigakura atakuja kupiga kura mbele ya meza na kuitumbukiza ndani ya box.

Mheshimiwa Spika, upigaji kura na idadi kamili ya kura zinazotakiwa kupigwa. Kila mpiga kura atatakiwa kupiga kura mbili kwa siri, kwa utaratibu niliouainisha kwa kuweka alama ya vema kwenye jina la Mgombea anayemtaka kama inayooneshwa kwenye karatasi ya kupigia kura. Mpiga kura ambaye kwa bahati mbaya ataharibu karatasi yake ya kupigia kura wakati wa zoezi la kupiga kura likiwa linaendelea, anaweza kuirejesha karatasi iliyoharibika na kupewa karatasi nyingine.

Mheshimiwa Spika, kuhesabu kura. Baada ya wapiga kura wote kupiga kura na kuzitumbukiza kwenye masanduku kama nilivyoainisha, Mheshimiwa Spika, kwa mujibu wa Kanuni ya 12(1) atawateua Wabunge wawili; mmoja kutoka

Chama Tawala na mwingine kutoka Kambi ya Upinzani kuwa Mawakala wa kuhesabu kura kwa Wagombea wote. Vile vile uzoefu unaonesha kuwa Mheshimiwa Spika anaweza kuruhusu Wagombea kushuhudia zoezi la kuhesabu kura wao wenyewe. Mara baada ya kura kukusanywa katika masanduku, mimi na wasaidizi wangu tutahesabu kura zilizopigwa mbele ya Mawakala walioteuliwa kwa zoezi hilo katika chumba maalum kitakachokuwa kimeandaliwa.
Mheshimiwa Spika, baada ya zoezi hilo la kuhesabu kura kukamilika, tutatoa maelezo ya Wabunge watakaokuwa wamechaguliwa na kuwatangaza rasmi kuwa Wabunge wa Bunge la Afrika Mashariki.
Mheshimiwa Spika, hayo ndiyo maelezo ya utaratibu wa zoezi la upigaji kura.

Waheshimiwa Wabunge, baada ya maelezo yangu ya utangulizi na baada ya maelezo ya Msimamizi wa Uchaguzi ambaye ni Katibu wetu, endapo kuna ufafanuzi wa ziada unaohitajika kabla zoezi letu halijaendelea natoa dakika chache sana kwa Mheshimiwa Mbunge yoyote ambaye kwa hatua hii anadhani kuna jambo halijakaa vizuri kidogo au linahitaji ufafanuzi wa namna moja au nyingine.
Nimewaona watatu. Mbona wanaongezeka! Makatibu niandikieni tu orodha sasa. Ukitajwa jina unakaa chini.
Mheshimiwa Lubeleje, Mheshimiwa Getere, Mheshimiwa Ikupa, Mheshimiwa Yussuf, Mheshimiwa Bobali, Mheshimiwa Maftah, Mheshimiwa Kadutu, Mheshimiwa Musukuma, Mheshimiwa Mulugo na Mheshimiwa Haonga.
Ahsante sana. Naomba sasa tuweze kuanza. Ni dakika mbili mbili tu, Mheshimiwa Lubeleje uanze.
Mheshimiwa Spika, nataka nipate maelezo tu kidogo kwamba tutakwenda kupiga kura
pale mbele. Je, meza itakuwa inatuita jina moja moja au tutakaa foleni?

Niseme tu, wakati huo utakapofika, Katibu atafafanua vizuri utaratibu mzuri ambao hauna tatizo, lakini emphasis ni kwamba tunataka uchaguzi wa uwazi, hatutaki mtu tena apige kelele wala aseme sijui nilionewa kwa namna moja au nyingine. Vitu vinafanyika, vinaonekana, sisi wote tukiwepo ni mashahidi wa kinachotokea kwa utaratibu mzuri kabisa ataueleza wakati huo Katibu. Waheshimiwa naomba kwa hilo msiwe na wasi wasi nalo.
Mheshimiwa Getere.

Mheshimiwa Spika, ahsante. Napenda kujua tu kwamba wakati tumefanya uchaguzi wa kwanza tulipewa karatasi hapa mezani na uchaguzi wa leo unasema mtu mmoja mmoja ataitwa. Je, uchaguzi wa kwanza ulikuwa umekosewa, utaratibu haukufuatwa?
Hilo siyo swali. Mheshimiwa Ikupa.
Mheshimiwa Spika, ahsante. Langu ni dogo, ni ombi tu, kwamba mimi nitaomba nipigie kura hapa nilipo na kura yangu iletwe hapo mbele. Ahsante.

Ahsante sana, tunatambua hilo. Utaratibu wa wale wenzetu na ndugu zetu ambao tunawapenda kabisa, Msimamizi wa Uchaguzi atauweka kwa utaratibu mzuri na tutatangaza wakati huo kwamba kura hii moja inaenda kule kwa ajili gani; wakati huo itakapofika.
Mheshimiwa Bobali.
Mheshimiwa Spika, swali langu lilikuwa linafanana kidogo na Mheshimiwa Getere, lakini kwa kuwa sisi wengine ni Wabunge wapya, tulitaka tujue tu utaratibu kwa nini siku ile tulipigia huku na leo
tunakwenda pale? Angalau kidogo, Wabunge wengi hapa ni wapya, ungetoa ufafanuzi tu kidogo ukaturidhisha maana tumekuwa so confused katika hili.
Mheshimiwa Maftaha.
Mheshimiwa Spika, ahsante. Nilitaka niulize swali ambalo Mheshimiwa Lubeleje kauliza, kwa hiyo, siwezi kuuliza tena. Ahsante.

Labda nilijibu hili, hivi; mtaona katika uchaguzi ambao tunapeleka ma-box kura zinazunguka huko, inafika mahali mtu mwingine anaweza akapewa hata kura mbili au tatu huko, Katibu asione wala mimi nisione; inatupa wasiwasi wa kuelewa kama kweli kura zetu ni hizo.

Wasiwasi wake mwingine mkubwa ni kwamba, wakati wa kwenda kuhesabu tumeshawaambieni wapiga kura ni wangapi, inaweza ikajitokeza tofauti ya kura tatu, nne. Unajua kura hizo zinamfanya mtu aende Mahakamani na inakuwa ni kesi nzito! Kwa hiyo, tunataka kuhakikisha kwamba zoezi linaenda katika namna ambayo sote kabisa tunashuhudia hapa.
Mheshimiwa Maftah, kama huna lingine ili tuokoe muda! Ndio aliongea mwisho eeh!
Mheshimiwa Spika, sina lingine ni lile la Mheshimiwa Lubeleje.
Ahsante sana. Mheshimiwa Musukuma.

Mheshimiwa Spika, nilitaka kupata ufafanuzi kwa mujibu wa Katiba ya Jamhuri ya Muungano wa Tanzania, Wabunge tunachaguliwa kwa sifa ya kujua kusoma na kuandika na Wagombea watajieleza kwa Kiingereza. Tunasikia Kiingereza lakini hatuwezi kuuliza maswali: Je, kwa mwongozo wako, hatuwezi kuwauliza kwa Kiswahili?

Jamani, msema kweli mpenzi wa Mungu, sasa ninyi mnacheka nini? Wako wengine hapa wanajifanya wanajua Kimombo kumbe hamna kitu! Afadhali hata mtani wangu Musukuma ame-declare interest. Hilo Katibu ambaye ni Msimamizi wa Uchaguzi atalijibu. Msimamizi wa uchaguzi katika hilo.
Mheshimiwa Spika, kwa mamlaka uliyonayo unaweza ukaruhusu swali liulizwe kwa Kiswahili, lakini anayejibu ajibu kwa Kiingereza.
Nini tena Mheshimiwa Nassari?

Mheshimiwa Spika, nashukuru kwa maelezo yaliyotolewa na Katibu wa Bunge, lakini kama ni kweli amejibu hoja iliyotolewa na Mheshimiwa Musukuma kwamba anayeuliza swali aulize kwa lugha ya Kiswahili kwa kutokujua Kiingereza kwa ile sifa ya K3 (Kusoma, Kuandika na Kuhesabu) kwa maana ya sifa za Wabunge kwenye Bunge hili, sasa swali langu kwako ni moja kwamba; kama anayeuliza anaruhusiwa kuuliza kwa Kiswahili, lakini anayejibu anajibu kwa Kiingereza, kuna translator humu ndani wa kusaidia kumjibu basi yule aliyeuliza swali ajue alichojibiwa ni kitu gani?
Mheshimiwa Mulugo.
Mheshimiwa Spika, nami ilikuwa hoja yangu kwa alilokuwa amelifanya Mheshimiwa Getere, lakini baada ya wewe kulifafanua, nimelielewa. Ahsante.
Mheshimiwa Haonga.

Mheshimiwa Spika, ili tuweze kuokoa muda, kwa sababu umeshatoa ufafanuzi, naomba niseme tu kwamba nami kidogo niliingiwa na hofu kwamba wale Wabunge wenzetu ambao tulishawachagua tayari siku za nyuma hatukutumia utaratibu kama wa leo;
sasa nilidhani labda kama utaratibu ulikosewa na wenzetu wale labda warudi ili tuweze kuwachagua upya. Sasa kwa sababu umeshatoa ufafanuzi, nashukuru sana.
Sasa Waheshimiwa Wabunge, kwa ajili ya kuokoa muda…

div.note: (Hapa baadhi ya Wabunge walizungumza bila mpangilio)

u.seg: Hapana, muda sasa umeenda. Upo kwenye orodha yangu, lakini muda Waheshimiwa.

Niseme mafupi yajayo ili tuweze kuanza zoezi, kwamba zoezi hili linatokana na Mkataba wa Jumuiya ya Afrika Mashariki. Katika Nchi zetu sita (Tanzania, Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi na Sudan ya Kusini) wanachagua Wabunge tisa tisa wa kutuwakilisha kwenye Bunge la Jumuiya ya Afrika ya Mashariki. Leo sisi hapa tunakamilisha zoezi kwa kuchagua wale wawili waliokuwa wamebaki kwa maelezo ambayo Katibu ameyaeleza kwa ufasaha mkubwa.

Kama kawaida kila nchi inajaribu kupeleka watu ambao inaamini kabisa kwamba watafanya kazi nzuri kule kwa kupambana na wale wengine wa nchi jirani katika mambo ambayo yana maslahi ya Tanzania. Kwa hiyo, nawaombeni Waheshimiwa Wabunge na kuwakumbusha, tuwasikilize kwa umakini, tuache kuongea ongea, tuwasikilize wanapokuja hapa, tuwaulize maswali, tupige kura, zihesabiwe tupate matokeo.
Sasa baada ya kuwa tumeulizana hapa, hakuna neno lingine, nimruhusu Katibu sasa kama ana lolote aseme, basi baada ya hapo tuanze kuita Wagombea wetu kwa mpangilio ambao Katibu ataueleza. Katibu.
Mheshimiwa Spika, nadhani umeyaeleza yote isipokuwa baada ya zoezi la Wagombea kujieleza na kuuliza maswali, nitarejea tena baadhi ya vipengele ili kuweka vizuri utaratibu
utakaotumika katika kupiga kura na Waheshimiwa muwe na amani tu kwamba kila Mbunge atapiga kura kwa utaratibu tulioandaa.
Pili, utaratibu tunaotumia ni utaratibu wa kawaida wa Kibunge ambao tumekuwa tukiutumia kwa mujibu wa kanuni. Hakuna jambo jipya katika utaratibu tunaoutumia.

Mheshimiwa Spika, zoezi la Wabunge kuja kupiga kura mbele ya meza hii kama ulivyoliweka vizuri ni kuondoa hisia ya uwepo wa kura ya ziada baada ya Wabunge kuhesabiwa na kupata idadi ya kura tofauti na kinyume na hesabu tunayokuwa tumehesabu. Tunashukuru kwa utaratibu huu, sasa kura zitahesabiwa kwa wale watakaokuja kuchukua mbele na kupiga kura na ndiyo itakayokuwa idadi kamili tutakayoitumia katika kuhesabu.

Mheshimiwa Spika, niliomba na hili nilieleze vizuri ili niwarejeshe Waheshimiwa Wabunge kwenye kanuni kwa maana huu ni utaratibu wa kawaida wa upigaji wa kura. Tunaweza tukaeleza wakati mwingine taratibu nyingi za kupiga kura ndani ya nyumba yako hii.
Mheshimiwa Spika, naomba sasa ili kuokoa muda, tuite Wagombea waje kwa utaratibu tuliouandaa, mmoja baada ya mwingine kama tulivyoeleza.

Ahsante sana. Nafikiri mmemsikia Katibu. Kwa utaratibu huu, maana tunaweza tukawa idadi fulani humu ndani tukaitangaza, lakini mtu mwingine hapa akaondoka zake au watatu, wanne, watano wakaondoka; matokeo yake ile idadi tuliyoitaja kama akidi na karatasi ambazo zinakwenda kuhesabiwa kule ndani zikawa na tofauti, ikatuletea shida. Kwa utaratibu huu, mtu akitumbukiza mle ndani ndiyo anatengeneza akidi.

Kwa hiyo, zile kura tutakazotokanazo hapa, ndiyo akidi yenyewe na ndiyo kura zote, kwa sababu wote tumeshuhudia kwamba hawa kweli ndio waliopiga kura na hakuna aliyerudia kupiga kura. Isipokuwa kama nilivyosema,
kwa wenzetu wenye mahitaji maalum tutawapelekea kura pale kwa kutangaza kwamba kura hiyo moja inaenda pale, ni fulani anakwenda kupiga kura na kadhalika.
Naamini kwa sasa tumefika pazuri, tumetumia nusu saa kwa ajili ya haya mambo ya utangulizi, sasa tuanze kazi ya kuwasikiliza Wagombea wetu. Katibu tuitie wa kwanza.
Tunaomba Seargent-at-arms amwite Profesa Abdallah Jumbe Safari.
Mpambe naomba uokoe muda, tuitie Mgombea Profesa Abdallah Safari. Wanatoka mbali kidogo Waheshimiwa, kwa hiyo, tuvumilie. Hatukutaka kulikisha mtihani.
(Hapa Mgombea Profesa Abdallah Jumbe Safari
aliingia Ukumbini na Waheshimiwa
Wabunge walianza kumpigia makofi)
Hapana, hapana!

You are cordially welcome. In front of you are members of Parliament, you will be given three minutes to explain why you are here and certainly identify yourself. After that if there are one, two or three questions you will be asked and I will ask you to answer them, after that you will be required to excuse yourself. The floor is yours now.

Honourable Speaker, Honourable Prime Minister, Honourable Leader of the Opposition; my name is Abdallah Safari. Before I proceed with my request to be elected to the East African Legislative Assembly, I wish to sincerely convey my condolences to the family of the 33 students and their two teachers and a driver who were tragically killed in a road accident that took place in Arusha.

Honourable Speaker, I am attending here to appeal to your Parliament to be elected to represent this honourable country to the East African Legislative Assembly. My profile is contained in the CV which has been distributed to the Members of this Assembly as well as a leaflet that I tried to distribute to most of the Members of this Honorable Assembly.

I hold a PHD from the University of Sussex in UK where I also taught a course known as „Comparative Criminal Justice Systems in the World.” I am also a Professor of Law, I have taught in many academic institutions including the University of Dar es Salaam where I taught The Law of Evidence and some of the best students are currently here, for instance Honorable Rweikiza and Honorable Adadi. I also taught The International Law at Mozambican - Tanzania Centre for Foreign Relations where I saved as the Director of Studies and Programmes.

I am author of about six books, one of each is being used in all Universities to teach criminal procedure and it is also used at The Law School of Tanzania and my other two books including „Harusi” was used as A-levels and to teach subject known as Stylistics at The University of Dar es Salaam Department of Literature. And my other book called „Joka la Mdimu,” is currently being used to teach literature at A- levels…
Honourable Professor, the three minutes are over. Now is time for questions if there are any. One from that corner, please proceed.
Honourable Speaker, Thank you. I am Oscar Mukasa from Biharamulo.

Yes Sir, the candidate, in a mixture of factors that can produce success with those that can produce failure, the product is failure. This statement was made by someone in the name of Jethro Spear and I would like to use it as a preamble before I pose my question to you.

In my opinion, we are failing quite well as a group of countries in this block in terms of the political will from the individual countries. But we are not moving on the same page when it comes to economic interest of the block as opposed to interest of the individual countries. Can you prove me wrong or right as you are asking for for my vote to represent our country in the council of Law makers in East Africa? Thank you.
Thank you contestant. Can you respond to that question!

Honourable Speaker, the objects of the East African Community is clearly stipulated in article 5 of the Treaty for The Establishment of The East African Community. And one of the main objectives is to ensure that the East African States will forge strategies to ensure proper political, economic and cultural development activities to benefit the people of these countries.

Therefore, what I am going to do if I will be elected to this August Assembly is to ensure that the interest of Tanzania are going to be best represented in the East African Legislative Assembly for the benefits of all Tanzanians.
The second question was from your neighbor there.

A MEMBER: Thank you Honourable Speaker. I have been going through the very big CV of the Professor, and my question does not intend to change the opinion of the voters in this House. Professor, do you believe in succession plan?
Sorry!
understood, understood. Can you respond that question? Are you a believer in the concept called succession plan?
I didn’t hear him properly. What did he say?
He asked you a simple question, are you a believer in the philosophy or a concept called succession plan? That is his question.
A MEMBER: Hilo ni swali hilo?

Honorable Speaker, succession plan! You see, succession can mean a lot of things, for example in law there is doctrine of state succession. If you mean succession in law, it means that this smooth transition of governments from one epoch to another. I am sure there could be other types of succession in other disciplines. Therefore, unless the question is much more specific on what type of successions it is intended. It is a bit vague.
The last question from HonoUrable Member.
Thank you Mr. Speaker.
Vipi?
Thank you Mr. Speaker.
Order in the House! Proceed please.
Thank you Mr. Speaker. Mr Safari I want to know your weakness before I vote. Thank you.
Order! Order! Order! The Member wants you HonoUrable Professor to tell him, what are your weaknesses and convince him to vote for you.
My weaknesses; I am not quite aware of any weakness. I am not
quite aware I have any tangible weakness that I have.
Thank you very much. Now I am giving you two minutes to wind up and ask for votes once more.

Ok. Honourable Speaker, I had distributed a leaflet spelling out my program at the East African Legislative Assembly. I am sure that Honourable Members of Parliament have gone through them and I don’t have to epitomize them. But finally I must say that the preamble to the East African Charter says that, the past East African Community failed because of certain factors. I am going to ensure that this East African Community is not going to fail and finally I am going to play the role of the link between this National Assembly and the East African Legislative Assembly.
I honourably request that you vote for me. I can assure you that I am going to represent this country very consciously and with a professional mind and integrity. Thanks a lot.
Thank you very much. You can now take your leave please.
Jamani, makofi yaacheni. Mgombea wa pili, Katibu.
Ezekia Dibogo Wenje.

Ezekiel Wenje, you are welcome. In front of you, beside you, behind you are Members of Parliament who are waiting eagerly for you to identify yourself and explain why you are here. After that exercise of three minutes, if there are some questions you will be asked to answer them, not more than three. Later on, you will have to leave us for the rest of the activities. The floor is now yours please. You have three minutes to explain.

Sir, thank you Honourable Prime Minister, thank you the Leader of Opposition, Honourable Freeman Mbowe, Ministers present and the Honourable Members of this House. My names are Ezekia Dibogo Wenje. Here I am again today before you to seek your votes to enable me represent our great Nation in the East African Parliament.
Mr. Speaker Sir, this election is very emotional but I want to tell you, it is just a day’s event. It will end today and we will be the same people tomorrow in the same country.

Mr. Speaker Sir, I stand here today with a strong conviction that East Africa and its people are one. We have a common shared history under common destiny as people of East Africa. Both of you are aware that long time ago before the Berlin Conference which divided East Africa into what it is today, East African people were one. We were only separated by rivers and valleys and beautiful mountains which our people could easily cross in search of pastures and food without being subjected into the colonial passports and visas.

Mr. Speaker, we are one and that is why the founders of these great Nations had this truth at heart and that is why immediately few years after independence they started beating drums loud, the drums of integration because they had this truth at heart.

Honourable Speaker, the seeds of integration that they sow, is the new East African Community that we have today. We are here before this House, both of us, to participate in this history to rewrite this history today, to water the seeds of integration that these great men sow those years back.
Mr. Speaker, I stand here today as a proud son of Africa, the writings are on the wall right now. Nobody can dispute the fact that we need to take strong men and women with strong characters…
Can you wind up now.
… into the East African Parliament to go and defend our country and our sovereignty.
Honourable Speaker Sir, thank you.
Thank you very much. Any questions to the candidate! Three questions already, we start from there, and then there, we will finish up here. You are welcome Honourable Member.

Honourable Wenje, The United Nations Agreement on the application of sanitary and phytosanitary standards demands equality among Nations in its enforcement. Now this agreement is appurtenant to the EAC Treaty and its subsequent protocols….
Honourable Speaker, I did not get him properly, can he come again? I can’t hear properly.
Honourable Speaker, let me make it close here.
The United Nations Agreement on the Sanitary and Phytosanitary Standards demands equality on its application.
.. Sanitary standards and what?
Sanitary and phytosanitary standards.
Sanitary?

Yes! You understand now? Ok! Demands equality in the enforcement. Now as an EALA MP, this agreement which is appurtenant to the EAC Treaty and its protocols, how are you going to stand to make sure that our products like meat and fish get through to the market without getting hard to these measures?
Can you respond to that question please.

Thank you Mr. Speaker Sir. If you read the East African protocols like chapter five and if you read about the Customs Union that includes the so called rules of origin, the best thing that our country can actually benefit from the regional product that we have like fish as he has said, is to make good use of the so called Rules of Origin which is in the Customs Unions Treaty. You see, as a country, for our products to be competitive we cannot compromise the sanitary standards set internationally.
Honourable Speaker, no matter what, we just have to encourage the manufacturers or producers of our products to put them to that good standard so that we be competitive.
Thank you Mr. Speaker Sir.
The second question, Honourable Maige.

Thank you very much Honourable Speaker. I have the following question to the candidate. You know that there is imbalance of labor force among the East African Member States; what do you understand by the term free labor movement protocol in the East African Member States. Thank you.
Free labor movement, can you explain.

Thank you Mr. Speaker Sir. There has been this notion that our people in our country are not getting jobs in other countries across the region simply because some people think we are not competent enough and that is why our people still feel that, you know if you go back to the economic protocol, one of the things that they talk about is free movement of persons and free movement

of labor. Our people still have reservations and feel that if we allow free movement of labor then our people will not get jobs elsewhere and some people from Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda will come in and take our jobs. This is not correct! I believe we have strong and competent manpower in this country, we have the same Universities as like Nairobi, we have the same Universities as like Kampala, we have the same Universities as like Rwanda University. We have competent young men and women in this country who can fight for the jobs not only in Tanzania and even across, even in Uganda we can go! We have competent people here.

Honourable Speaker, I can assure you, we have very competent Members of Parliament here. They have gone through the same Universities which I have also gone through. I believe if we are put on the same table with Kenyans, Ugandans, we can prove them wrong, that is why some of us who believe we are competent, take us there, we go and prove to them that we have strong men and women in this country, we can defend our sovereignty, we can defend our integrity.
Thank you Mr. Speaker Sir.
Thank you very much. The last question from this side.

Honorable Speaker, thank you very much. I would like to ask a question to the contestant right here. Mr. Wenje, you just seem to be a worshipper of commonalities in East Africa and you are talking about…
Worshipper of what?
Commonalities…
Commonalities?

Yes! Commonalities in East Africa. You are talking about this integration just you want people to integrate equally within East African Regional Integration. So my question is; so long as we have started to talk about the Former East African Integration that was declined in 1977 if I am not mistaken and there were some kind of problems that made to decline that kind of integration…

I am sorry, can you wait a little bit. Member, can you listen to me before you proceed? What you are doing is, you are addressing the candidate. Can you put forward a question, straightforward, no organization. Put the question forward, you will be answered, it is over.

Thank you Honorable Speaker. My question is, how are you going to assure us that if we are just going to elect you as a Member of Parliament in EALA that you are going to defend Tanzania interest in East African Community?
Can you respond to that question?
Mr. Speaker Sir, if I heard him correctly, it is like he doubts my ability to go and represent our country.

Mr. Speaker Sir, he also talked about commonality. I am a strong believer that Africa and its people are one and in East Africa in particular, and that is why if you go across border you will find some Maasais in Tanzania ana some are in Kenya. You will find Luos like me here, some are in Shirati and some are in Kenya; you will find Kuryas some are in Tanzania and some are in Kenya; you will find the Kondes, some are there and some are in Zambia. We are one people! What divide us is only colonial boundaries.
Mr. Speaker, I am a son of this land. This is the land of my ancestors; this is the land of my fore fathers. I can defend the sovereignty of our country at any cost across our borders.
Give me the opportunity to fly high the flag of our country and I will do it without any doubt.
Thank you. Mr. Speaker Sir.
Thank you very much, thank you candidate. I am now giving you two minutes to wind up your speech and ask for votes once more. After that I will ask you to leave.

Honourable Speaker, Honourable Prime Minister, Members of Parliament here; as I said earlier, this an election is just a day’s event. We will be the same people tomorrow, in the same country; you will be the same Members of Parliament tomorrow in the same Parliament. The writings are on the wall, let us arise all together to do justice to our country by sending competent and strong people who can defend the sovereignty of this country. I believe I am such one character who can go and work for our country. I ask you to support me and I request your votes. Thank you so much.
Thank you very much and now you are free to leave. Thank you very much.
Waheshimiwa Wabunge, bado naendelea

kuwaomba, Wagombea wanapojieleza hapa na wamekuja kwa ajili yetu, ni vizuri tukawasikiliza. Pana minong’ono mingi, husikilizi! Kama nilivyosema, huenda tunaonekana huko, sasa Watanzania wanashangaa, hivi hawa watu wanashindwa kuwa na dakika mbili, tatu tu za kumsikiliza mtu? Katibu, anayekuja mwingine!
Josephine Sebastian Lemoyan.

Josephine, in front of you are members of parliament. In a few minutes I will ask you to speak to them, introduce yourself and explain your mission here. Later on there are might be some questions up to three of which you
will asked to answer them and later on you will leave. I am now giving you three minutes, the floor is yours, please proceed.

Thank you very much your Honor Speaker of the United Republic of Tanzania; your Honor the Prime Minister of The United Republic of Tanzania; I recognize the presence of the Leader of the Opposition in the House; Honourable Members of the Parliament; members of Media Houses; good evening ladies and gentlemen.

My names are Josephine Sebastian Lemoyan. I am standing before you with deep heart felt sympathy towards the calamities and demise of our children following the accident that has occurred a few days ago in Karatu. Let me offer my heart felt deep sympathy to you, your Honor Mr. Speaker Sir, as well as the parents, friends, relatives and the family of Tanzania as a country.

My credentials has been presented, but I would like to go back to them just to set the record right. I am a woman, a mother and a daughter of Tanzania, holding a Master’s degree in Sociology and Master of Science in Applied Social Research.

Mr. Speaker Sir, I am coming before this August House of the Parliament of United Republic of Tanzania requesting very humbly that I am sent on a mission to go and represent Tanzania in East African Legistrative Assembly whereby I am going to join fellow colleagues whom you have elected a few days ago. My mission and why am I interesting to go to EALA is because I red the strategic plan for East Africa Community 2015 which has a number of issues which I think, I can contribute to.
My background is in Social Sciences and I think I can make a contribution using experience expertise and my knowledge.
Can you windup your speech now! Windup.

I think I can make that contribution because I have done well and I have done so much not only because I have the education, but the experience in working with the government for more than 30 years where by issues of policy analysis, research were done.

Thank you very much. Three questions if any? I have seen three candidates now. We will start from that end and then come from that middle position then the last question will come from hear. The man behind in black please.
Thank you Honorable Speaker…
Proceed!

My name is Mbogo. I would like to ask Madam; you have said that you have good experience and knowledge but we know we have four pillars in East Africa Community. Now, can you tell us what challenges do we have on the current pillars we have adopted and if we elect you as EALA member, how are you going to address these challenges?
I could not hear you properly.
Did you hear, his question?
Not quite really, I did’nt hear the question.
Speak closer, put closer that microphone or you use the neighbouring one.

Alright. I can just go back again. You have said that you have good experience and knowledge on various matters and you have gone well on the East Africa Communities as our Regional Integration East Africa. There are almost four pillars and two already adopted but we have challenges. Now can you tell us how are you going to address these challenges we have; and how are you going to attack the remaining two pillars which are not yet adopted by the East Africa Community?
He means adopted. Can you answer?

Thank you very much Honorable Speaker and thank you very much for your question. Yes indeed, there are four pillars of integration for our East Africa Community and the first one is custom union, which paves the way towards Common Market and the third one is the Monitory Unification and lastly is about the Political Federation.

Now, the quiet a number of challenges across the four pillars and in so far as second pillar is concern and first one as well, there are quiet a number of non-tariff barriers as well as tariff barriers that have not been addressed. The recent report on East Africa Community annual performance indicates that 104 non-tariff barriers has been actually addressed and between 16 and 20 are not yet addressed, a new ones are emerging. Now, how am I going to…
Thank you very much. Thank you member. Thank you candidate.
Matha Umbulla I saw you.
Mr. Speaker Sir…

Thank you Honourable Speaker. The land scarcity in other East African countries may force the citizens of other East African countries to forge in the strategies of intermarriage so that to attain a land
ownership from Tanzania. Now as a woman MP in EALA, in case of such behavior, how are you going to discourage it?
Can you respond to that question?

Yes Mr. Speaker Sir. Thank you very much for your question. I think you are talking about the land issues and land grabbing, and if that is the question as a woman MP what I am I going to do in order to address the question of land grabbing in our country?

First of all, I had been working for quite some time on land issues and woman participation on land issues and just recently on the 18th of March, 2017, a new Act on gender and Non-discrimination Act has been passed. I am going to facilitate and contribute towards making that legislation known to the women as well as making it popular so that women understand what they have to do in so far as land issues are concern. Thank you.
The third question. No clapping please! Honorable Saada.

Thank you Honourable Speaker. Miss Josephine, if I am not mistaken, one of your researches during your education background was about drug abuse among the young generation particularly in Tanzania. As a woman, as a mother, as well we expect I do know if you are going to pass through well as a woman MP, what is your take about the challenge of drug abuse among the young generation? And what are you going to do; your special initiative to address the challenges among East Africa countries and as well as a region? Thank you.
Can you respond to that question, candidate?
Honourable Speaker and Madam Saada thank you very much for the question. Yes indeed, child abuse is a critical issue and in a

young block like the East African Community we have more than 33 percent of its population as children. My take is going to be working together with the team of Tanzania as well as other country MPs to ensure that we legislate on issues of child abuse taking on board lessons that we have learnt from Tanzania so that we make our country proud. Thank you very much.
Thank you candidate. No clapping. I am now giving you two minutes to windup your presentation and once more ask for votes before you leave. Go ahead.

Thank you, Mr. Speaker Sir, Honourable Members of the Parliament, Josephine comes forward to you pleading that you send me to become a servant in EALA, holding hands together with other colleagues whom you have been elected just a few weeks ago. I am humble woman, I am very much willing to run when I am told to run, I can walk from here to Juba if that is necessary; and I am going to make sure that I hold my country dear in my heart and work together as a team with others.
Ladies and Gentlemen, Honourable Speaker Sir, Honourable Member of Parliament, I bag for your votes.
Thank you very much. No clapping! Thank you Josephine, now I ask you to leave and wish you all the best. Please!
Katibu, mwingine.
Lawrence Kego Masha.
Waheshimiwa Wabunge, nime-notice kitu kimoja, kumbe tungefanya sheria hapa tuwe tunachangia Kiingereza, ule ukorofi wote ungekwisha humu ndani.
Kesho!
Kesho eeh? Wanaoafiki kesho!
Ndiyooo!
Wooote mmekataa.

Lawrence, in front of you are Members of this August House, you will be given three minutes to identify yourself and then explain your mission why you are here and later on if there are any questions not more than three, you will be asked to answer them. You have the floor.
Thank you, Mr. Speaker.

Honorable Speaker, Honorable Prime Minister, Honorable Leader of the Opposition, Ministers, Members of the Parliament; my name is Lawrence Kego Masha, I am aspirant the office of being a member of East Africa Legislative Assembly.

However, Honorable Speaker, though you I would like to take this opportunity to give my heartfelt condolences to the President of United Republic of Tanzania, the people of Tanzania and particularly the people of Arusha and most importantly to the families who lost the beloved ones and that fateful vehicular accident that took place in Karatu the other day. May the Lord bless the souls of the departed in ever last in peace.

Mr. Speaker, three to four weeks ago I stood in this August Hall to request the votes to become a member of the East African Legislative Assembly. Unfortunately, the vote was insufficient and hence I stand before for you once again. My cv has been circulated, my record well known, so I will take one or two minutes simply to give you additional inside as to who I am and my character.
Mr. Speaker, in 1960 my father left Sengerema for the United States, he was inspired by John F. Kennedy who is inaugural address said don’t ask what your country can do

for you but ask what you can do for your country. It is a sentiment my father lived by, it is a sentiment he has embeded in his children. My father came back to this nation saved as a Member of Parliament; I was fortuned enough to save in fourth phase government an opportunity for which I am trully grateful. And my young brother is a Colonel in Tanzanian Army, ready and willing to die for this country as when required.
I am standing before you to ask to save my nation once again, I am patriotic Tanzanian I would like to use the skills which I have to save the nation I love.
Mr. Speaker, Honorable Prime Minister, Honorable Leader of the Opposition, Ministers and Member of Parliament, my I kindly have your votes.
Questions if any? Hapa CUF kiingereza tatizo? Maana sioni maswali. Naona maswali CCM tu, inaelekea… Leo ndiyo tutajuana hapa leo!
Haya, tuanze Mheshimiwa pale kwanza, halafu tutakuja mitaa hiyo.
Thank you Honorable Speaker for giving me a chance to ask the candidate a question.

Mr. Masha, you know that South Sudan is one of the country that join East African Community very recently. But we all know that they are still in war and lot of human rights abuses in South Sudan. What is your take in this, do you think it was bit premature to invite it in the treaty? Thank you.
Your opinion is thought, candidate can you respond to that?
Yes Honorable Speaker.
One must be understood is that, the strategic reasons in letting South Sudan to become a member of East African

Community, part of the very issues you have just raised are some is very reasons South Sudan was allowed to come in, so they could be closely monitored, so that we can actively take part in ensuring that there is peace in South Sudan; ensuring that they would not be able to disrupt neighbours within the region. I am sure although there are problem in South Sudan you are aware that there are problem in Burundi as well and the potentially problems in some of the other states. These are not reason for exclusion, what we must do is insure that, one, we work with our government to ensure as best as possible we can facilitate peace in South Sudan as we have tried in the past.

Kwa upande wangu wa kulia ukifika kwa Waziri Mkuu ubaki hapo hapo, usimame hapo kwa Waziri Mkuu mpaka ukiona nafasi ndiyo usogee na upande huu ukifika kwa Kiongozi wa Upinzani usipitilize, bakia hapo hapo mpaka ukiona nafasi ndiyo usogee.
Yule mtu wa IT wa Bunge, onesha Bunge na siyo kuonesha hapo wanapopiga kura.
Kushoto kwangu, Makatibu wazuieni hapo, asivuke mtu mpaka kuwe na nafasi hapo ya kupiga kura ndiyo asogee mbele. Kushoto kwangu usitoe karatasi mpaka kuwe na nafasi ya mtu huku.
Utaratibu umeanza kuvurugwa.

Mnaotoa karatasi za kura msitoe mpaka pawe na vacancy, maana yake utaratibu ukivurugika ni ninyi mnaotuvuruga. Usitoe karatasi mpaka pawe na nafasi ya kupiga kura. Kama nilivyosema, kwa wale Waheshimiwa ambao mmeshapiga kura na mnaona mnaweza mkapata chochote kitu, kuna mchapalo hapo nje.

Nakuomba Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika kama utaweza kujiunga na wenzetu wa European Union pale na utuwakilishe na Waheshimiwa Wabunge kama umeshapiga kura ruksa kupata chochote kitu pale halafu baadaye tena unarudi humu ndani au ukaamua kwenda moja kwa moja, yote ruksa tu. Wale ambao wanataka kubaki na sisi waendelee kubaki na sisi.
Mheshimiwa ambaye hujapata karatasi sasa sogea mbele. Wewe mwenyewe mtoa karatasi sogea hapo mbele sasa, kwa sababu mstari wako ni huo unaokuja huko sasa.

Waheshimiwa Wabunge, Mheshimiwa Ndaki anawaomba kama kuna Mbunge yeyote ameokota funguo za gari, itakuwa ni gari yake alete hapa mezani ili tuweze kumpatia. Ufunguo wa gari endapo kuna Mheshimiwa yeyote ameuona mahali au ameokota anaweza kutuletea kwa Katibu hapa mezani ili tuweze kumpatia Mheshimiwa Ndaki. Tuendelee kupiga kura, naona tunaendelea vizuri, karibu tutamaliza zoezi.
Katibu wangu wa kulia huku unatoa karatasi nyingi kwa wakati mmoja, toa karatasi pale tu panapokuwa na nafasi ya kupiga kura ambayo iko wazi.
Ahsante sana, picha ninayopata hapa ni kwamba Wabunge wote wameshapiga kura Makatibu, sogeeni pembeni kabisa kwanza. Eeh, sogeeni kwangu huku.
Mheshimiwa Mbowe na Mheshimiwa Jenista Mhagama mpaka sasa, kila mmoja kwa nusu dakika, tuwasikie. Mpaka sasa are you okay? Mheshimiwa Mbowe.
Mheshimiwa Spika, mpaka sasa hivi process ni salama na sahihi.
Ahsante sana. Mheshimiwa Jenista Mhagama, mpaka sasa?

Mheshimiwa Spika, kama kawaida ya viwango vyako vya usimamizi na upangaji wa mambo na umahiri wako katika kazi hii ya Uspika na usimamizi wa shughuli za Bunge, mpaka sasa tuko sawa sawa kabisa na umelisimamia jambo hili vizuri.
Ahsante sana, nashukuru. Katibu kinachofuata.

Mheshimiwa Spika, sasa ni kupata Mawakala kutoka upande wa Chama Tawala na Chama cha Upinzani na wagombea wenyewe au kama wanawateua wawakilishi. Baada ya hapo, tunakwenda kwenye zoezi la kuhesabu kura.
Ahsante. Naomba wagombea waruhusiwe sasa na Sergeant-At-Arms waingie hapa ndani wote. Hamkuwaweka kwenye chumba maalum hapo jirani au wameenda kwenye mchapalo!

Karibuni sana wagombea kama mko, karibu hapo. Wagombea, mnakaribishwa tafadhali. Ahsante sana. Mnaweza kusimama hapo hapo. Karibuni sana wagombea. Kuanzia sasa ndiyo tunaanza ile process ya kuhesabu kura.
Kura zimeshapigwa, maboksi hayo manne mnayoyaona hapo ndiyo yenye kura zenye uamuzi wa nani ni nani katika zoezi hili.

Sasa tuanze na wale Wawakilishi wa Kambi. Katibu ulisema mmoja kila upande, au! Lakini ili kufanya zoezi hili liwe zuri zaidi, nami nawaongezeni tena mmoja, yaani upande huu leteni wawili na CCM leteni wawili. Tutajieni wasimamizi apart from watakaowataja wao.
Mheshiniwa John Mnyika na Mheshimiwa Kunti Yusuph.
Nawaomba Mheshimiwa Kunti na Mheshimiwa John Mnyika msogee mbele, mje msimame hapo mbele ya Kiongozi wa Upinzani. Mheshimiwa Jenista kwa upande huu.
Mheshimiwa Spika, tutampeleka Mheshimiwa Ester Mahawe na Mheshimiwa Khadija Aboud.

Nawaomba watajwa wasogee hapa mbele. Karibuni sana Mheshimiwa Ester na Mheshimiwa Khadija, karibuni sana mkae hapo mbele ya dawati la Mheshimiwa Waziri Mkuu, msimame hapo. Karibuni hapo mbele, mbele zaidi, karibu na kwa PM hapo ili kila mtu awaone. Sogeeni tu, msiyaogope hayo masanduku, ndiyo kazi yenu, ndiyo maana mmeitwa. Eeh, hapo hapo hapo.

Sasa Wagombea mnaruhusiwa ama kwenda ninyi wenyewe ama kutuma wawakilishi wenu. Kwa hiyo, twende kama tulivyokuwa tunaingia hapa ndani. Tuanze na Profesa Safari halafu anayefuata, anayefuata. Kama unaingia mwenyewe au kama mwakilishi, ruksa.

Profesa, sasa bahati mbaya hayupo, inabidi uangalie katika walioko humu ndani. Nenda mwenyewe Profesa, eeh kabisa! Upendo tafadhali songa mbele ahsante, aliyefuata tafadhali mtajwa njoo mbele. Anayetajwa maana yake ukimtaja mtu maana yake wewe hutashiriki huku ndani utakaa nje kusubiria.
Aliyefuata! Thank you, songa mbele huku, sogea.
Anayefuata, tafadhali Mheshimiwa Halima jiunge nasi. Anayefuata, ahsante, songa mbele, ahsante sana. Eeh, Pamela, Pamela, sorry.Ahsante, songa mbele. Ahsante sana.

Basi kwa ninyi nawaruhusu. Sergeant kuna chumba chetu mahali pale, wanaweza wakakaa kwenye chumba chetu kulia pale, hawa wagombea wakapumzika pale ili wasi-hang. Ahsante sana. Basi Katibu sasa maelekezo yako ili zoezi liweze kuendelea.

Kuna chumba kilichoandaliwa nyuma yangu hapo, Speaker’s Lounge. Msiondoke kwanza, yabebeni hayo masanduku. Mnaobeba, wale Makatibu kila mmoja awe na lake, baada ya hapo twende upande mmoja. Upande gani tunaenda? Ehe, haya. Tufuatane na myasindikize masanduku ninyi wenyewe. Karibuni sana na mnaruhusiwa kupata chai ya Spika huko. Kuna mchapalo mdogo huko ndani.
Katibu tunakuomba timu yako ifanye chap chap kwa sababu bahati nzuri kura za leo wala siyo nyingi. Wanahesabu kura mbili mbili tu, naamini hata nusu saa inaweza isifike tutakuwa tumeshapata majibu.
Nashukuru sana Mheshimiwa Jenista wewe unaweza kubaki, lakini Mheshimiwa Mbowe akitaka anaweza akatoka kidogo.
Ahsante sana, nawashukuru. Sawa sawa.

Waheshimiwa Wabunge, nafurahi kuwafahamisha kwamba zoezi la uhesabu kura limekamilika. Kwa hiyo, sasa ni wakati muafaka tumruhusu Katibu wetu ambaye ndiye Msimamizi wa Uchaguzi aweze kutusomea matokeo ya kazi yetu. Katibu wa Bunge, tafadhali.
MATOKEO YA UCHAGUZI
Mheshimiwa Spika, naomba sasa nitoe matokeo ya uchaguzi Kundi C - Vyama vya Upinzani Chama cha CHADEMA kama ifuatavyo:-
Mheshimiwa Spika, idadi ya Wabunge wote Kikatiba ni 393, idadi ya Wabunge waliopo na kuapishwa 391, idadi ya kura zilizopigwa 296, idadi ya kura halali 296, hakuna kura iliyoharibika.
Mheshimiwa Spika, matokeo ya kura ni kama ifuatavyo:-
(a) Profesa Abdallah Jumbe Safari amepata kura
(b) Ezekia Dibogo Wenje amepata kura 34;
(c) Josephine Sebastian Lemoyan amepata kura
(d) Lawrence Kego Masha amepata kura 44;
(e) Pamela Simon Massay amepata kura 200; na
(f) Salim Mwalimu Juma amepata kura 59.
Matokeo haya yamethibitishwa na Wasimamizi wa uchaguzi na wametia saini zao katika karatasi hii.
Mheshimiwa Spika, kwa sababu hiyo basi, Mheshimiwa Josephine Sebastian Lemoyan na Mheshimiwa Pamela Simon Massay ndio washindi wa uchaguzi huu.
Mheshimiwa Spika, ni vizuri kuweka kumbukumbu sahihi, kwa kuwa hawajatangazwa kuwa washindi. Kwa hiyo basi, kwa mamlaka niliyopewa chini ya Kanuni ya 13(b) ya
Nyongeza ya Tatu ya Kanuni za Kudumu za Bunge Toleo la Januari 2016, napenda kuwatangaza Wabunge hao kuwa ni Wabunge wa Bunge la Nne la Afrika Mashariki.
Mheshimiwa Spika, kwa muktadha huo na matokeo haya naomba kutoa maelezo yafuatayo:-

Mheshimiwa Spika, kwa matokeo ya uchaguzi huu wa leo, napenda kutoa taarifa kwamba Bunge lako Tukufu limekamilisha kazi yake ya kuchagua Wabunge tisa wa Bunge la Afrika Mashariki kama inavyotakiwa kwa mujibu wa Ibara ya 50 ya Mkataba wa Uanzishwaji wa Jumuiya ya Afrika Mashariki. Wajumbe waliochaguliwa na Bunge hili katika uchaguzi uliofanyika tarehe 4 Aprili na uchaguzi uliofanyika leo tarehe 10 Mei, 2017 ni kama wafuatao:-

Mheshimiwa Fancy Haji Nkuhi, Mheshimiwa Happiness Elias Lugiko, Mheshimiwa Dkt. Abdullah Hasnu Makame, Mheshimiwa Mariam Ussi Yahya, Mheshimiwa Engineer Habib Mohamed Mnyaa, Mheshimiwa Dkt. Ngwaru Jumanne Maghembe, Mheshimiwa Adam Omari Kimbisa, Mheshimiwa Josephine Sebastian Lemoyan na Mheshimiwa Pamela Simon Massay.
Mheshimiwa Spika, naomba kutoa shukurani kwako wewe binafsi kwa kuongoza kikao hiki vizuri na kwa kuzingatia Kanuni.
Mheshimiwa Spika, naomba kutoa Taarifa.

Ahsante sana, Katibu wa Bunge. Nami napenda kuchukua nafasi hii kuwashukuru sana kwanza Wagombea wote waliojitokeza kugombea nafasi hii ya kutuwakilisha kama Wabunge katika Bunge la Afrika Mashariki kupitia vyama mbalimbali, kutoka kwenye michakato ya ndani ya vyama na hata wale ambao waliweza kufika hatua ya kufika mbele ya Bunge letu na kupigiwa kura na Waheshimiwa Wabunge, nawapongeza wote kabisa kwa kujitokeza kutumia haki yao ya kidemokrasia na

ninavipongeza vyama kwa michakato mbalimbali ambayo wameitumia katika kuleta wagombea. Kipekee nawapongeza sana Waheshimiwa Wabunge wa Bunge hili la Jamhuri ya Muungano wa Tanzania kwa kuwachekecha na kuwachuja na kuona hawa tisa waliosomwa na Msimamizi wa Uchaguzi kwamba ndiyo waliochaguliwa na Bunge hili kutuwakilisha katika Bunge la Afrika Mashariki kwa miaka mitano ijayo.

Kwa hiyo, nawapongeza sana waliochaguliwa na ninawaomba wale ambao hawakupata fursa hii wasivunjike moyo, huu ndiyo utaratibu wa demokrasia yetu. Tuendelee kujaribu wakati mwingine, nafasi nyingine zikitokea. Bunge hili kama alivyotangaza Katibu, katika Wabunge wale tisa wanaokwenda Afrika Mashariki, watano ni wanawake na wanne ni wanaume.

Kwa hiyo, cha muhimu tu kwetu sisi kwa Wabunge wote hawa tisa na kipekee kwa Wabunge hawa wanawake waende kule wakatubebe kwa heshima kubwa. Wakienda kuleta za kuleta kule, safari ijayo sidhani kama Bunge hili litaenda njia hiyo. Kwa hiyo, wanabeba dhamana kubwa sana. Uzoefu umeonesha wanaume hawana matatizo.

Waheshimiwa Wabunge, kwa kweli kwa muda ulipofika hapa na kwa kuwa shughuli ambazo tulipanga siku ya leo zimekamilika, naomba sasa nichukue fursa hii kuwataarifu kwamba kesho tutaendelea na Wizara ya Maji, mijadala kama kawaida na kesho kutwa pia. Kwa hiyo, niwahakikishie Waheshimiwa Wabunge wote ambao mmejiorodhesha, kwa kiasi kikubwa karibu wote mtaongea katika Wizara hii muhimu sana kwa zile siku tatu ambazo tulikuwa tumezipanga tangu mwanzo.
Kwa jinsi hiyo basi, nichukue fursa hii sasa kuahirisha shughuli za Bunge hadi kesho saa 3.00 asubuhi. (Saa 3.54 Usiku Bunge liliahirishwa Mpaka Siku ya Alhamisi,
Tarehe 11 Mei, 2017, Saa Tatu Asubuhi)
